resources.string: Locks automatically after 5 minutes without interaction.

Return to raum. with the home button. The kiosk is re-enabled when maintenance mode is locked.

Allows full access via cable/Wi-Fi. Only for service work – disable it again afterwards.
raum. becomes a normal app: no kiosk, no default home screen, no display off. The status can only be restored via ADB or a device factory reset.
Rooms, devices, scenes, automations and settings – encrypted with a backup password. Not included: administrator PIN, log and Matter fabric keys.
Install a signed raum. update (.apk) from USB. A recovery point is created automatically first.
The backup cannot be restored without this password. Please keep it safe.
The current configuration will be replaced completely. The log is kept.
Signature verified. raum. restarts after installation; automations pause briefly.

All devices are removed from the raum. fabric and the fabric keys are deleted. Devices that are also shared with other systems (e.g. Apple Home, Google Home) stay connected there. To use them with raum. again, they must be re-added with their setup codes.
Deleted: devices, scenes, automations, log, administrator PIN.\nKept: home name, rooms, display and location settings.
Deleted: everything – home, rooms, devices, scenes, automations, settings, log, administrator PIN, recovery points. raum. then starts as if new.
The Android system itself and kiosk operation stay unchanged. Tip: create a backup first.

Notes for new residents:
 - raum. was reset before handover; the devices are no longer connected to the panel.
 - Add devices again using their Matter setup code (label on the device).
 - Set your own administrator PIN on first start.

Scan the QR code or enter this code:

First, all other apps (e.g. Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa) lose access to the devices – reachable devices are removed there. If this cannot be confirmed for every device, raum. lists them before anything is deleted. Then all devices are removed from the raum. fabric and the fabric keys are deleted. Please factory-reset unreachable devices on site.
raum. acts as a Matter bridge: pair the panel once in Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa or SmartThings – all shared devices appear there. New devices are added automatically.

Commands go through this panel: if it is off or offline, the devices cannot be controlled in the other app. In return one code is enough, and Thread devices are reachable without a Thread hub of their own. Names are transferred, rooms are not.
%1$s loses access to all devices shared through raum. Directly shared devices stay there.
Deselected devices disappear from connected apps. New devices are shared automatically.

A border router connects Thread devices to your home network – e.g. HomePod mini, Apple TV, Nest Hub, Echo or an OpenThread Border Router.

Apple, Google and Amazon do not hand out their Thread credentials.
Pair new Thread devices there and share them with raum. using a code – or take over the credentials from Home Assistant or an OpenThread Border Router.
